name: 02668 · W Barnstable, MA
findings: ZIP 02668 (W Barnstable) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02668 (W Barnstable) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02668 (W Barnstable) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 11% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
